decisions.reason: The white-label test pressing series builds on the in-house label and the firm's collector positioning, so management has invested and committed visibly. Limited-run test pressings fit the collector niche, and any weak sales can still be read as a temporary ramp-up in the series' first year.

The German new wave compilation series is close to the firm's core catalog business and has been publicly launched as an ongoing series with several volumes. Compilations remain sellable from back-catalog stock at little ongoing cost, so management is very likely to persist with it.
